package loud

import (
	"context"
	tm "time"

	"pfm/internal/clock"
)

// A comment naming tm.Sleep( is never judged.
func wait(c context.Context) {
	tm.Sleep(1)
	<-tm.After(1)
	_, _ = context.WithTimeout(c, 1)
	_ = tm.Now().Before(tm.Now())
	_ = tm.Since(tm.Now())
	_ = clock.Real
	_ = "exec sleep 120"
	_ = "near timeout 1"
}
